_about: RepEat additions where free-exercise-db has no entry for a standard exercise people need at home or with bands: a band curl and row, and backpack-loaded curls, rows and triceps extensions for training with no equipment (a school bag filled with books is the usual Indian home weight). Same shape as exercises.json; no photos.

exercises.name: Band Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band, feet hip-width apart, holding an end in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, curl your hands up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly against the band's pull.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Band Curl
instructions: Stand on one end of a resistance band with the foot on your working side and hold the other end, palm forward.
Keeping the elbow at your side, curl the hand up towards the shoulder.
Lower slowly. Finish every rep on one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Band Pushdown
instructions: Anchor a resistance band high (over a door or a hook) and hold one end with one hand.
With the elbow tucked at your side and bent, push the hand down until the arm is straight.
Let it rise slowly. Finish every rep on one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Band Seated Row
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight and loop a resistance band around your feet, holding an end in each hand.
Sit tall and pull the hands towards your lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until the arms are straight, without rounding forward.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the handle in one hand, arm straight, palm forward.
Keeping the elbow at your side, curl the kettlebell up towards your shoulder.
Lower slowly. Finish every rep on one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Backpack Curl
instructions: Fill a backpack with books or water bottles and hold it by the top loop or a strap in one hand.
Keeping the elbow at your side, curl it up towards your shoulder.
Lower slowly. Finish every rep on one side, then switch. Add books as it gets easy.

exercises.name: Backpack Row
instructions: Fill a backpack with books. Put one hand and knee on a chair or bed, back flat, and hold the bag in the other hand.
Pull the bag up towards your hip, elbow close to your body, squeezing the shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight. Finish every rep on one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Backpack Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold a loaded backpack by its top loop in one hand and press it straight overhead.
Keeping the upper arm still, lower it behind your head by bending the elbow.
Straighten the arm back up. Finish every rep on one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Backpack Triceps Kickback
instructions: Hold a loaded backpack by its top loop and support yourself with the other hand on a chair, back flat.
Lift the upper arm parallel to the floor, elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Straighten the elbow to push the bag back, then bend it slowly. Finish every rep on one side, then switch.
